analysis.summaryJa: このページは現在完了を『過去から今へ橋を架ける形』として整理し、完了・経験・継続・現在の結果という4つの見方を共通する『今との関係』から理解する。形はhave/has＋過去分詞で、疑問・否定でもhave/hasを軸に組み立てる。
grammarPoints: have/has＋過去分詞で現在完了を作る
just/already/yetで完了・未完了を表す
since/forで過去から現在までの継続を表す
過去の出来事が作る現在の結果を表す
Have/Has＋主語＋過去分詞の疑問形とhave/has notの否定形
visualEvidence: source-jsonはhave/has＋過去分詞を過去→今の橋として中央に置く
just packedで完了、seen twiceで経験、since Aprilで継続を示す
left his compass at homeで現在の結果を示す
肯定・疑問・否定の形を別パネルで整理している
commonTraps: 現在完了を単なる過去形として解釈する
疑問文でDidを使って現在完了の意味を失う
yet/already/justの位置と意味を混同する

questions.prompt: We ------- the final draft already, so it is ready to send.
questions.translationJa: 最終稿はすでに完成しているので、送信準備ができています。
questions.explanationJa: alreadyと現在の結果があるため現在完了です。

questions.prompt: Ms. Chen ------- Tokyo four times for business.
questions.translationJa: チェンさんは仕事で東京を4回訪れたことがあります。
questions.explanationJa: 今までの経験回数なので現在完了です。

questions.prompt: The support team ------- with this vendor since 2022.
questions.translationJa: サポートチームは2022年以来この業者と取引しています。
questions.explanationJa: sinceで過去から現在までの継続を表します。

questions.prompt: Mr. Davis ------- his access card, so he cannot enter the lab.
questions.translationJa: デイビスさんは入館カードをなくしてしまい、研究室に入れません。
questions.explanationJa: 紛失の結果が今の状態につながるため現在完了です。

questions.prompt: The courier has ------- delivered the replacement part.
questions.translationJa: 宅配業者は交換部品をたった今配達しました。
questions.explanationJa: justは直近の完了を現在完了と結び付けます。

questions.prompt: Have you ------- used this booking system before?
questions.translationJa: これまでにこの予約システムを使ったことがありますか。
questions.explanationJa: everは今までの経験を尋ねる現在完了と相性がよいです。

questions.prompt: We have not received the signed contract -------.
questions.translationJa: 署名済み契約書をまだ受け取っていません。
questions.explanationJa: yetは現在まで未完了の否定文で使います。

questions.prompt: The company has operated this service ------- ten years.
questions.translationJa: その会社はこのサービスを10年間運営しています。
questions.explanationJa: 期間の長さten yearsにはforを使います。

questions.prompt: The branch has been open ------- April.
questions.translationJa: その支店は4月から営業しています。
questions.explanationJa: 開始点Aprilにはsinceを使います。

questions.prompt: Has the manager ------- the request yet?
questions.translationJa: 部長はその依頼をもう承認しましたか。
questions.explanationJa: 現在完了疑問文はHas＋主語＋過去分詞approvedです。

questions.prompt: Choose the correct sentence about a task just finished.

choices.A: I just finished the report yesterday now.
choices.B: I have just finish the report.
choices.C: I have just finished the report.
choices.D: I am just finished the report.

questions.translationJa: 報告書をたった今仕上げました。
questions.explanationJa: have＋過去分詞finishedとjustで直近完了を表します。

questions.prompt: Choose the correct sentence about life experience.

choices.A: She never has flew business class.
choices.B: She has never fly business class.
choices.C: She never flew business class so far.
choices.D: She has never flown business class.

questions.translationJa: 彼女はこれまでビジネスクラスに乗ったことがありません。
questions.explanationJa: neverを使う経験の現在完了でhas＋過去分詞flownです。

questions.prompt: Choose the correct sentence with “since”.

choices.A: We have used this software since January.
choices.B: We used this software since January and still do.
choices.C: We are use this software since January.
choices.D: We have use this software since January.

questions.translationJa: 私たちは1月からこのソフトを使っています。
questions.explanationJa: 開始点since Januaryから現在までの継続です。

questions.prompt: Choose the correct sentence with “for”.

choices.A: He managed the store for six years and still manages it now.
choices.B: He has managed the store for six years.
choices.C: He has manage the store for six years.
choices.D: He is managed the store for six years.

questions.translationJa: 彼は6年間その店を管理しています。
questions.explanationJa: 今も続く期間をfor＋現在完了で表します。

questions.prompt: Choose the correct sentence about a present result.

choices.A: The printer stopped in 2019, so only that date matters.
choices.B: The printer has stop, so we cannot print.
choices.C: The printer has stopped, so we cannot print.

questions.translationJa: プリンターが停止した結果、今印刷できません。
questions.explanationJa: 過去の停止と今の状態を現在完了で結びます。

questions.prompt: Choose the correct present-perfect question.

choices.A: Did you received the invoice yet?
choices.B: Have you receive the invoice yet?
choices.C: Are you received the invoice yet?
choices.D: Have you received the invoice yet?

questions.translationJa: 請求書をもう受け取りましたか。
questions.explanationJa: Have＋主語＋過去分詞receivedの形です。

questions.prompt: Choose the correct present-perfect negative sentence.

choices.A: We did not completed the test yet.
choices.B: We have not complete the test yet.
choices.C: We have not completed the test yet.
choices.D: We are not completed the test yet.

questions.translationJa: 私たちはまだ試験を完了していません。
questions.explanationJa: have not＋過去分詞completedで現在まで未完了を表します。

questions.prompt: Choose the correct sentence about repeated experience.

choices.A: Mr. Ito attended the conference five times yesterday.
choices.B: Mr. Ito has attend the conference five times.
choices.C: Mr. Ito is attended the conference five times.
choices.D: Mr. Ito has attended the conference five times.

questions.translationJa: 伊藤さんはその会議に5回参加したことがあります。
questions.explanationJa: 回数で今までの経験を表す現在完了です。

questions.prompt: Choose the correct sentence about a recent result.

choices.A: The rain has stopped, so the event can resume.
choices.B: The rain stopped last Tuesday, so only then mattered.
choices.C: The rain has stop, so the event can resume.
choices.D: The rain is stopped now by yesterday.

questions.translationJa: 雨がやんだのでイベントを再開できます。
questions.explanationJa: 現在の再開可能という結果に焦点があるため現在完了です。

questions.prompt: Choose the correct use of since and for.

choices.A: She has lived here for 2020 and worked since four years.
choices.B: She has lived here since 2020 and has worked here for four years.
choices.C: She lived here since 2020 and still lives here.
choices.D: She has live here since 2020 and has work here for four years.

questions.translationJa: 彼女は2020年からここに住み、ここで4年間働いています。
questions.explanationJa: sinceは開始点、forは期間の長さを表します。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: “I have just sent the email.”

choices.A: The email was sent moments ago and that matters now.
choices.B: I sent the email at 3 p.m. yesterday.
choices.C: I send the email every day.
choices.D: I am planning to send it later.

questions.translationJa: メールをたった今送信し、その結果が現在に関係しています。
questions.explanationJa: justを伴う現在完了は直近の完了を表します。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: “She has visited Rome twice.”

choices.A: She visited Rome twice on one named past day.
choices.B: She is in Rome now necessarily.
choices.C: Her experience up to now includes two visits to Rome.
choices.D: She visits Rome twice every month.

questions.translationJa: 彼女はこれまでにローマを2回訪れています。
questions.explanationJa: 今までの経験回数を表します。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: “We have known each other since college.”

choices.A: We knew each other only during college.
choices.B: Our relationship began in college and continues now.
choices.C: We met yesterday for the first time.
choices.D: We know each other only at work today.

questions.translationJa: 大学時代から現在まで知り合いです。
questions.explanationJa: sinceの開始点から今まで続く継続です。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: “I have misplaced my keys.”

choices.A: I misplaced them at exactly 2 p.m. yesterday and only that matters.
choices.C: I am putting them away now.
choices.D: I cannot find my keys now because I misplaced them.

questions.translationJa: 鍵を置き忘れた結果、今見つけられません。
questions.explanationJa: 現在の結果を強調しています。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: “Have you ever used this service?”

choices.A: I am asking about your experience at any time up to now.
choices.B: I am asking what time yesterday you used it.
choices.C: I know you use it daily.
choices.D: I am telling you to use it now.

questions.translationJa: これまでのどこかで利用経験があるか尋ねています。
questions.explanationJa: everは経験の現在完了疑問文です。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: “We have not decided yet.”

choices.C: The decision is still pending now.
choices.D: We are deciding only at a past time.

questions.translationJa: 決定は現在もまだ保留です。
questions.explanationJa: yetを伴う否定で今まで未完了を表します。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: “He has worked here for eight years.”

choices.A: His work started eight years ago and continues now.
choices.B: He worked here for eight years but certainly left.
choices.C: He works here eight times a year.

questions.translationJa: 8年前に働き始め、今も続いています。
questions.explanationJa: for＋期間の継続です。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: “The shop has been open since May.”

choices.A: The shop was open only in May.
choices.B: The shop opened in May and remains open now.
choices.D: The shop is opening at this exact second.

questions.translationJa: その店は5月に開店し、今も営業しています。
questions.explanationJa: sinceで開始点から今までの状態継続を示します。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: “The train has already left.”

choices.A: The train left at 8:00 yesterday only.
choices.C: The departure happened before now, so the train is no longer here.
choices.D: The train is about to arrive.

questions.translationJa: 電車はすでに出発し、今ここにはいません。
questions.explanationJa: alreadyと結果の現在完了です。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: “Has she finished the report?”

choices.A: I am asking exactly when yesterday she finished it.
choices.B: I know she finishes reports daily.
choices.C: I am asking whether she is starting it now.
choices.D: I am asking whether the report is complete now.

questions.translationJa: 報告書が現在完了しているか尋ねています。
questions.explanationJa: 現在完了疑問文は現在に関係する完了を確認します。

questions.prompt: The client is waiting for the final file. We ------- just uploaded it.
questions.translationJa: 顧客は最終ファイルを待っています。私たちはたった今アップロードしました。
questions.explanationJa: just＋現在完了なのでhave＋uploadedです。

questions.prompt: This is her third visit to the site. She ------- been here twice before.
questions.translationJa: 今回が彼女の3回目の訪問です。以前に2回来たことがあります。
questions.explanationJa: 今までの経験をhas beenで表します。

questions.prompt: The partnership began in 2019 and continues today. We ------- worked together since then.
questions.translationJa: 提携は2019年に始まり現在も続いています。それ以来ずっと一緒に仕事をしています。
questions.explanationJa: since thenで継続する現在完了です。

questions.prompt: The door will not unlock. Someone ------- left the security latch on.
questions.translationJa: ドアの鍵が開きません。誰かが安全ラッチをかけたままにしたようです。
questions.explanationJa: 過去の行為の結果が今の状態に残るため現在完了です。

questions.prompt: The shipment is ready. The warehouse team has ------- packed all 20 boxes.
questions.translationJa: 出荷準備ができています。倉庫チームは20箱すべてをすでに梱包済みです。
questions.explanationJa: alreadyで現在までの完了を示します。

questions.prompt: The contract is still missing. We have not received it -------.
questions.translationJa: 契約書はまだ届いていません。まだ受け取っていません。
questions.explanationJa: 現在まで未完了の否定にはyetを使います。

questions.prompt: The new analyst joined us in March and is still here. She has worked with us ------- March.
questions.translationJa: 新しい分析担当者は3月に入社し今も在籍しています。3月から働いています。
questions.explanationJa: Marchは開始点なのでsinceです。

questions.prompt: The subscription started six months ago and is active now. We have used the service ------- six months.
questions.translationJa: 契約は6か月前に始まり今も有効です。6か月間サービスを利用しています。
questions.explanationJa: six monthsは期間の長さなのでforです。

questions.prompt: The customer says this is her first complaint. She has ------- reported a problem before.
questions.translationJa: 顧客によると今回が初めての苦情です。以前に問題を報告したことはありません。
questions.explanationJa: 経験の否定をnever＋現在完了で表します。

questions.prompt: The manager wants a status update. ------- the team completed the review yet?
questions.translationJa: 部長は進捗確認を求めています。チームはもうレビューを完了しましたか。
questions.explanationJa: 現在までの完了をHas＋主語＋過去分詞で尋ねます。
